scope: Seeded from Campaign 3 verdicts and qualification reports, extended through VER-C3-HABIT-001. Not a completed audit of all historical or Campaign 0-2 limitations.

obligations.title: Common evidence and absent-motive influence
obligations.distinction: Evidence support versus motive ownership and role/sign partitions
obligations.established: VER-C3-MULTI-002 discharges the immediate public source/receiver debt:43 distinct frozen models,62 public runs,227 prefix restores and62 final-code whole-save reexecutions. Authentic shared observations preserve separate task/body grounds; independent replenishment, orphan removal, duplicate and collective descriptions are public controls. Matched DescriptionDice controls have identical actual raw bytes. GroundAggregate retains the orphan-influence boundary; role-blind FamilyNormalized violates it in the bounded candidate domain. Construction and codec defects are preserved with regressions.
obligations.unresolved: The universal receiving law, role-aware normalizers, wider motive/source families and arbitrary identifier-renaming/order invariance remain unqualified. Conditional status is not closure of those claims.
obligations.reopenTrigger: Any receiving reduction, role-aware normalizer, new motive family, wider source domain or arbitrary renaming/order-invariance claim.
blocks: Whole PHEN-MULTI-001 qualification
Receiving reduction claiming shared/independent motive equivalence
obligations.doesNotBlock: Unrelated bounded Campaign 3 work; completed bounded GA qualification.
obligations.closureRequirement: The immediate authentic public fixture requirement is discharged by VER-C3-MULTI-002. When a broader claim triggers this obligation, run matched public controls over its affected domain and explicitly retain or supersede the orphan-influence, description/motive and collective-redundancy constraints. The qualification report collects six scoped transfer constraints, including safe-observation noninterference and intent/execution separation; preserve their held-fixed assumptions and do not turn orphan inertness into a ban on separately contracted evidence effects.

obligations.title: Concern modulation law
obligations.distinction: Encoding suppression versus retrieval amplification; competing A/B/C response shapes
obligations.established: The ratified transient-state feedback seam has bounded discriminating comparisons; TaskConcern is not general Affect.
obligations.unresolved: Final response curves and broader psychological necessity remain unresolved.
obligations.reopenTrigger: New downstream curve discrimination, required affect source or proposed merger of encoding and retrieval feedback.
blocks: Universal concern-law selection
Reduction merging the distinct feedback arms
obligations.doesNotBlock: Unrelated bounded Campaign 3 work; completed bounded GA qualification.
obligations.closureRequirement: Run the affected phenomenon with named A/B/C competitors and separate encoding/retrieval observations; record scoped verdict.

obligations.title: Retrieval response ceiling
obligations.distinction: Fixture crossover versus structural response bound
obligations.established: The present response family has omegaA <= 2; increasing gain cannot pass a crossover at or above 2.
obligations.unresolved: A larger response range is neither required by the current fixture nor ruled out generally.
obligations.reopenTrigger: A required fixture needs reordering with crossover >= 2, or a reduction claims unrestricted response sufficiency.
blocks: Qualification of that harder fixture using the current bounded family
Unrestricted retrieval-response sufficiency claim
obligations.doesNotBlock: Unrelated bounded Campaign 3 work; completed bounded GA qualification.
obligations.closureRequirement: Compare an explicitly contracted wider-response family when triggered; do not treat a gain change as escaping the bound.

obligations.distinction: Independent/shared/hybrid allocation, encoding, association and later accessibility
obligations.established: Exact strengths, graph weights and scores discriminate candidates even when winners agree. Retired flat remains a negative control.
obligations.unresolved: No universal resource/allocation law or general footprint immunity is established.
obligations.reopenTrigger: Broader source/footprint or scale, changed resource law, or proposed reduction based on equal winners.
blocks: Universal salience/resource-law selection
Encoding/access merger based only on winner equality
obligations.doesNotBlock: Unrelated bounded Campaign 3 work; completed bounded GA qualification.
obligations.closureRequirement: Preserve exact intermediate observables, resolving scales and shared/independent/hybrid controls over the affected corpus before reduction.

obligations.unresolved: Long-horizon discrimination and general protection priority remain open.
obligations.reopenTrigger: Longer-horizon or conflicting use/significance pressure, or proposed removal/merger of significance protection.

obligations.title: Bounded belief versus general inference and confidence
obligations.distinction: Observer evidence versus truth, belief versus appraisal, opportunity versus silence, evidence weight versus calibrated uncertainty
obligations.established: VER-C3-BELIEF-001 qualifies nine frozen models/48 public runs/381 whole-prefix restores and next-step equalities. Fixed-truth false belief, contradiction, goal-only appraisal, observer-safe opportunity gating, absent-versus-zero and exclusive consequence ownership are traversable. VER-C3-AFFECT-001 adds a separately contracted three-key observed-trial successor and fallible relative/absolute mitigation contrasts without widening frozen BELIEF.
obligations.unresolved: General belief law, correlated evidence/repeated reports, learned trust or quality, scalar censored inference, calibrated uncertainty, general causal attribution, controllability and efficacy outside the qualified controlled AFFECT contrast and current-phase30 application remain unqualified. Confidence tau/(tau+1) measures accumulated admitted weight and can rise under contradiction; it is not probability of correctness.
obligations.reopenTrigger: New evidence class, repeated/correlated reports, current-lane or same-event use, trust/quality inference, broader condition recognition, confidence calibration, scalar censoring, causal attribution/controllability/efficacy, or a belief/appraisal reduction.
blocks: Universal belief/confidence law
General Research Brief12.4 qualification
Current-lane belief application inferred from this profile
obligations.doesNotBlock: Completed bounded PHEN-BELIEF-001 and PHEN-AFFECT-001 realizations; separately contracted future consumers using admitted operands.
obligations.closureRequirement: For each triggered extension, specify exact admitted sources and owner/boundary semantics, retain historical MEC-001/002 and P3-001/002/003/011 controls, and run matched public contrasts preserving false belief, correction, absent-versus-zero and no-evidence inertia. Resolve ORD-001 explicitly before current-lane application.

obligations.title: Affect factor sources and public psychological discrimination
obligations.distinction: Predicted threat, mitigation belief, derived affect, grounded motive and later cognitive influence
obligations.established: VER-C3-AFFECT-001 qualifies the bounded public source/appraisal/affect/reasons/execution/later-feedback path:18 frozen models,91 main runs,1236 complete-prefix restores and1236 continuation equalities, plus14 supplementary timing/interior-feedback executions. Actual observed trial membership/action/outcome produces three conditional estimates. Independent factors, same affect/different action, relief without belief learning and strict later feedback are executable. All three serious affect candidates have nonzero interior feedback witnesses.
obligations.unresolved: Universal factor/control/feedback laws and scalar equivalence remain unresolved. The selected receiving maps do not establish a necessary two-coordinate psychology. Unknown/partial-factor affect, calibrated uncertainty, broader mitigation/causal identification, social and retrospective affect, extinction/generalization, physiology, long-horizon dynamics and general action/affordance discovery remain outside this controlled source and fixed-plan profile.
obligations.owner: AFFECT factor sources, appraisal feedback and future representation reduction
obligations.reopenTrigger: A proposed affect reduction or scalar-equivalence claim; new mitigation/source or uncertainty domain; a new feedback target/horizon; social or retrospective affect, extinction/generalization, physiological dynamics or general action discovery.
blocks: Universal affect/control/feedback law
Scalar psychological equivalence or necessity of SplitExposure without independent receiving evidence
General affect under uncertainty, social/retrospective affect or broad causal efficacy inferred from controlled trials
obligations.doesNotBlock: Completed bounded PHEN-AFFECT-001, BELIEF, GA and BODY/MULTISOURCE; workspace/control readiness using their qualified boundaries.
obligations.closureRequirement: For each triggered extension, admit its sources, owners, ordering and receivers explicitly and run discriminating public comparisons. Retain false-belief, unknown/zero, no-evidence inertia, genuine reason grounds, matched affect/competing motive and strictly later feedback controls. Establish representation necessity or equivalence on independently motivated psychological observables, not a receiver selected solely to reward the representation.

obligations.title: Workspace/control beyond retained-history reconstruction
obligations.distinction: Retained availability versus maintained active access; maintenance/control versus stateless priority; retained intention versus expired goal
obligations.established: VER-C3-WORK-001 qualifies the bounded PHEN-WORK-001 realization with 48 models,78 public runs,624 complete-prefix restores and continuation equalities. StoredSet and IndexedReplay have equal cognitive outputs; the latter derives active access without a cache. Overload, distractor-only displacement/protection, cue return, expiry, source safety and grounded choice are executable.
obligations.unresolved: General maintenance/indexing law and efficiency, larger/changing pools, decaying history, new adoption or fulfillment, ordinary cue recognition, retrieval integration, inhibition under load, fatigue, rumination, strategy switching, performance monitoring, reappraisal and control costs remain unqualified.
obligations.reopenTrigger: Any larger or changing source/lifecycle domain, history deletion, control-order change, alternate maintenance mechanism, claimed cache reduction beyond the tested domain, or newly required Brief12.6 phenomenon.
blocks: Universal workspace/control qualification
Removing maintained access or all active-set caches from the architecture
Claiming inhibition, fatigue, strategy switching, monitoring or reappraisal from this bounded fixture
obligations.doesNotBlock: Completed bounded WORKSPACE/CONTROL, GA, BODY/MULTISOURCE, BELIEF and AFFECT; readiness for PHEN-SKILL-001.
obligations.closureRequirement: When triggered, preserve separately traceable retained/active state and replay matched public discrimination tests, including genuine overload, exact single-factor interventions and expired-cue controls. Re-derive indexed access for any new lifecycle or missing-history case; do not silently reuse the fixed-deadline proof. WORK-DESIGN-001 requires isolating the manipulated factor.

obligations.title: Procedural skill beyond the controlled single exercise
obligations.distinction: Actual competence, observed performance belief, temporary impairment, intention and outcome; truth-side practice versus character-side evidence
obligations.established: VER-C3-SKILL-001 qualifies bounded PHEN-SKILL-001 with27 frozen models,52 public runs,279 complete-prefix restores/continuation equalities. Actual skill and impairment change execution with equal intent/expression; practice can improve competence without observed feedback; false feedback changes performance belief without competence; recovery preserves retained skill.
obligations.unresolved: General practice/impairment and competence representation laws, multiple procedures, rust, transfer, automaticity, precision/error distributions, execution noise, ordinary recognition, attribution/source quality, latent competence inference, separately composed outcome prediction, confidence-sensitive choice and body/control/workspace integration remain unqualified.
obligations.owner: Procedural adaptation, execution and capability-belief seams
obligations.reopenTrigger: A new skill/practice/impairment domain, another learning law, richer performance attribution or capability inference, confidence-sensitive choice, proposed skill/memory/habit reduction or new body/control/workspace integration.
blocks: Universal SKILL or Brief12.8 qualification
Treating empirical performance expectation as identified latent competence or calibrated confidence
Reducing procedural adaptation to observation-based belief updates
obligations.doesNotBlock: Completed bounded SKILL, WORKSPACE/CONTROL, AFFECT, BELIEF, BODY/MULTISOURCE and GA; PHEN-SOCIAL-001 readiness.
obligations.closureRequirement: On a trigger, accept the new source/contract and run matched public controls retaining exact intent/expression equality under hidden physical changes, separate actual/observed performance, lawful practice without feedback, impairment-only recovery without practice, and separate mutation authorities. Preserve serious learning/impairment alternatives and explicitly test any new competence-belief/outcome-prediction distinction.

obligations.title: Social inference beyond the controlled two-observer commitment profile
obligations.distinction: Target private state, observer-permitted communication, observer-owned person belief, source correlation and relationship history
obligations.established: VER-C3-SOCIAL-001 qualifies bounded PHEN-SOCIAL-001 with 18 frozen models, 26 runs and 127 complete-prefix restores/continuation equalities. Fixed displays hide private commitment; selective fallible explanations alter only recipient belief; repeated receipts do not supply independent corroboration.
obligations.unresolved: Ordinary recognition, trust/source quality, uncertain correlation, hearsay, richer person states and dispositions, nested beliefs, relationship history, downstream social appraisal/actions, reciprocal interaction and general privacy tooling remain unqualified. Snapshot ordering and closed observer projection do not close general ORD-002/TRC-003.
obligations.owner: Person-model, communication, interaction-ordering and epistemic projection seams
obligations.reopenTrigger: A new communication or recognition channel, hidden source correlation, source reliability, another person-model proposition, nested or reciprocal inference, relationship coupling, social appraisal/action or a new projection consumer.
blocks: Whole Brief12.10/12.13 or universal SOCIAL qualification
General ORD-002/TRC-003 closure
Treating communication as truth transfer or person belief as relationship history
obligations.doesNotBlock: Completed bounded SOCIAL, SKILL, WORKSPACE/CONTROL, AFFECT, BELIEF, BODY/MULTISOURCE and GA; PHEN-HABIT-001 readiness.
obligations.closureRequirement: Accept successor contracts and run private-only/access-only/explanation-only pairs preserving observer isolation, mistaken inference and correction, false explanation, correlation and alternative learners. Qualify newly exercised ordering, recognition, relationship and privacy clauses independently.

obligations.title: Habit beyond availability-mediated acquisition and reversal
obligations.distinction: Acquired action history, current explicit expectation, candidate availability, deliberate preference, identity, skill and physiological adaptation
obligations.established: VER-C3-HABIT-001 qualifies bounded PHEN-HABIT-001 with 12 models,23 runs,291 complete-prefix restores/continuation equalities. Rewarded action history preserves target availability after corrective evidence makes expectation neutral; later observed negative action outcomes remove it. DerivedHistory and StoredSummary produce equal safe behavioral bytes under all three laws; a separate stored summary is not required in this domain.
obligations.unresolved: General habit acquisition/extinction/threshold and reward laws, stronger deliberate counter-reasons, inhibition/control, broader cues/attribution, partial schedules, episodic or associative alternatives, compression, long horizons, identity/body/skill integration, substitutes, dependence, tolerance, withdrawal, craving and relapse remain unqualified. No architecture-box deletion or general memory/habit reduction follows.
obligations.owner: Habit learning, candidate construction, explicit expectation, control and embodied adaptation seams
obligations.reopenTrigger: A stronger counter-motive or control demand, new cue or reward/source domain, partial reinforcement schedule, a proposed history compression or memory/habit reduction, identity/body/skill coupling, addiction/dependence or longer retention horizon.
blocks: Whole Brief12.9 or general addiction qualification
Interpreting candidate availability as compulsive preference
Deleting habit/episodic/association/identity distinctions from the architecture on the basis of cache equivalence
obligations.doesNotBlock: Completed bounded HABIT, SOCIAL, SKILL, WORKSPACE/CONTROL, AFFECT, BELIEF, BODY/MULTISOURCE and GA; PHEN-REL-001 readiness.
obligations.closureRequirement: Accept successor contracts and compare acquired-history effects under equal current belief and other contributors. Preserve current-reward-only, explicit-belief-only, NoHistory, serious learning laws and derived/stored alternatives. Independently qualify stronger preference/control, richer memory, body and addiction clauses when triggered.
